name: No-Bake Cheesecake
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 200 g (7 oz) tennis biscuits or digestive biscuits, crushed to fine crumbs
540 g (19 oz) cream cheese, softened to room temperature
750 g (26.4 oz) tinned sweetened condensed milk

steps: Combine melted butter with biscuit crumbs. Press into a pie dish to make a crust.
Beat cream cheese until smooth and fluffy.
Beat lemon juice and condensed milk together.
Mix the condensed milk mixture into beaten cream cheese until thoroughly combined.
Pour filling into the prepared pie dish.
Refrigerate for minimum of 24 hours until set.

culture.text: Cheesecake is a dessert made with a soft fresh cheese, and sugar, with either eggs or cream depending if it is to be baked or not. It may have a crust or base made from crushed cookies, digestive biscuits, graham crackers, pastry, or sometimes sponge cake. Cheesecake is known for its rich, creamy flavor and smooth texture. It may be baked or unbaked and is usually served chilled.
